reason: The stems are fading, so I want to lift the crop into the basket and see what grew.
expectation: I expect harvested potatoes, though I don't know their condition or amount.

alternatives.reason: Watering could help the plants, but fading stems suggest it is time to harvest.

effect: The crop has produced solid potatoes, so I can sort some for the next planting.
reaction: Seeing the potatoes larger than the original seed pieces is a satisfying payoff for the long wait.
reason: I want to select healthy seed stock before preparing the harvest to eat.
expectation: The sorting bench will separate suitable potatoes for planting; I don't know what criteria it will show.

alternatives.reason: Washing the potatoes would start the meal, but I want to secure seed first.

effect: Seed potatoes are set aside; I can turn to the meal.
reaction: The outcome is clear but I am curious how the healthy ones were selected.
reason: Washing the harvested potatoes is a natural first step toward eating them.
expectation: I expect clean potatoes ready for preparation.

effect: The potatoes are washed and ready to prepare.
reaction: This is a predictable practical step.
reason: Cutting the clean potatoes should prepare them for cooking.
expectation: I expect cut potatoes for the oven.

effect: The potatoes are cut, so oil is the next cooking preparation offered.
reaction: Another straightforward kitchen step; little surprise so far.
reason: Oil should help prepare the cut potatoes for roasting.
expectation: I expect oiled potato pieces ready for the oven.

effect: The pieces are oiled and the oven is available.
reaction: The preparation matches my expectation, though the sequence is rather routine.
reason: The oven should cook the prepared potatoes for the harvest meal.
expectation: I expect roasted potatoes and a chance to taste them.

effect: The potatoes are roasted and eaten, completing the harvest after saving seed.
reaction: The radio hiss makes the meal feel quietly solitary; that detail stays with me.

mostWorthwhile.text: Lifting the potatoes was the most satisfying: the unseen crop finally appeared, larger than the seed pieces after months of care.

leastWorthwhile.text: Washing, cutting, and oiling were clear but a fairly routine sequence with little decision-making.

surprise.text: The ordinary hiss during the meal gave the payoff a lonely tone I did not expect.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the seed selection gave no indication of what made the stock healthy.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens with the discovery and the return, though this chapter's cooking sequence alone would not strongly motivate me.
